jurisdiction_character.standing: A frontier trade hub that operates semi-independently, permitting unregulated commerce and trade diversity.
jurisdiction_character.resolves_tag: The record's tag asked to "clarify jurisdiction"; this is the clarification. Semi-independence is the standing condition, not an anomaly.

black_district.name: Rethos IV Black District.
black_district.description: The largest unregulated trade hub, where Union authority holds no power.
black_district.handling: Recorded as a named district of this world rather than minted as a separate location: source treats it as a quarter of Rethos IV, and no placement or extent is established for it.

trade_context.role: Named as one of the galaxy's major trade hubs alongside Vel-Surak, within a trade infrastructure of supply corridors and Union-controlled lanes carrying standing piracy risk.
trade_context.contrast: Vel-Surak is the recorded economic capital under Union order; Rethos IV is the hub that operates outside it. The pair frames regulated against unregulated commerce.

prose_ledger_triage.excluded: One metatextual line approving how the trade infrastructure was handled. The Vel-Surak economic-capital claim needed no action — loc_vel_surak already records it.
